newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish SDP activists oppose 1999 EMU entry - poll.
newsitem.headline: Swedish SDP activists oppose 1999 EMU entry - poll.

text.p: Most local activists of Sweden's minority ruling Social Democrats want Sweden to stay outside Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) at its 1999 start to be able to see how it works, Dagens Industri newspaper said on Friday.
A survey by the newspaper showed that 178 local Social Democratic representatives out of a total 350 thought Sweden should wait and see and possibly join EMU at a later stage.
Three representatives were in favour of joining from the start, 36 opposed membership and 133 had not decided.
The representatives will take a decision at the party congress in September about whether the party should support a link to EMU.
The party leaders are due to make a final decision in May, which will have a large impact on local representatives' opinions, the newspaper added.
